about_the_game:
3 Nights of Terror lets you dive inside the nightmare-driven dreams of police officer Scott Harris, who suffers from an extreme form of Parasomnia. Guide him through his horrifying nightmares, and make sure he wakes up in the morning. 

The Story

Scott Harris is a dedicated police officer at the local Rockville Police Department. Lately, his toughest fight has begun in his own mind. He suffers from severe Parasomnia, a sleep disorder that leaves him exhausted in terrifying nightmares.

His hope lies in an experimental brain surgery scheduled in three days. This is his last chance to reclaim control over his mind and escape the horrifying nightmares that plague him. Until then, Harris has to endure three more nights of pure terror.

Every time Harris falls asleep, he is trapped in strange and terrifying dreams. The only thing guiding him is his blurry memories of police work, pushing him to keep going and find answers. But with each night, the nightmares feel more real, and the line between dream and reality starts to disappear.

Who can he trust when even his own mind turns against him? Let’s guide him in the psychological horror nightmares and ensure he wakes up in the morning! 


Night 1: The Maze

Harris wakes up in an underground maze. He needs to find fuses and install them into electrical panels, in order to activate the exit door, to escape his dream. But he has to be careful, because he is not alone down there.

Night 2: The Hospital

Waking up in his own bed, Harris realizes that something is off about his surroundings. Upon further investigation, he finds himself in a pitch dark hospital, which is occupied by a monster that reacts to sound. Since his only light source is the Flash of an old camera, he has to put a lot of thought in each of his actions.

Night 3: The Shelter

In his final dream before surgery, Harris gets called in to a potential hostage situation at the local homeless shelter. Armed with hes department issued firearm, He has to neutralize all threats on the scene, and rescue the civilians, who have locked themselves into a panic room.

Features:

  • Three unique nightmares: Explore a dark maze, escape a haunted hospital, and eliminate unknown entities at an abandoned Homeless Shelter.

  • Intense Gameplay: Each level has unique challenges to ensure an amazing horror adventure.

  • Immersive atmosphere: Each nightmare is filled with tension, danger, and mystery.

  • Terrifying Creatures: Each night introduces a new horrifying creature with unique AI behavior and skills.

  • Various equipment: To further extend the uniqueness of each level, the player gets to use different equipment for each dream. Namingly: Interactive Map, Camera, Gun

short_description: 3 Nights of Terror lässt dich in die Albträume des Polizisten Scott Harris eintauchen, der an einer extremen Form von Parasomnie leidet. Führe ihn durch seine grausamen Träume und überstehe die Nächte, um sicherzustellen, dass er am Morgen wieder aufwacht.
